'''JW-1306''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was kept on the [[Unmasked research station]] by [[the Unmasked]]. During the [[mission to the R-4 anomaly]] he escaped and aided the [[Alliance Commander]] in their destruction of the station, but was killed in the process.<ref name="operation" />
